name: Can I install my own bathroom plumbing fixtures?

mainEntity.name: Can I install my own bathroom plumbing fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible for a homeowner to install some simple bathroom plumbing fixtures, complex installations or alterations to existing plumbing systems are best left to a professional. Incorrect installation can lead to leaks, water damage, or violations of local plumbing codes. A professional ensures proper connections, correct drainage, and adherence to all regulations for safety and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple fixture installation can be DIY, but complex work is best handled by a professional to avoid issues.
